t: After Years of Testing Bedding, These Are the Best Places to Shop
s: December 16, 2025 - If you’re looking for bamboo sheets, Cozy Earth is one of the best places to buy bedding. We loved the Cozy Earth Bamboo Sheet Set when we tried it. The sheets have a supremely soft texture, keep cool throughout the night, and boast a high-end construction. While Cozy Earth is definitely on the higher end of the bedding price range (at press time, the brand's bedding products ranged from around $90 to over $600), we’ve found the selection is high-quality and design-forward.
